mobbin:7c04e7a5-ee31-4531-9e1a-fc413f10c.summary: From a timestamped transcript playback view the user enters edit mode, corrects a word inline with the keyboard while the scrubber stays available, then exits with the corrected selection visible.
steps: Transcript: Speaker 1 at 0:26, highlight, playback bar
Edit mode: select typo MVCreally, keyboard up
Edit mode: cursor in highlighted phrase, Done in header
View mode: MVP really selected, pencil in header
steal: A speaker block and start timestamp on every paragraph (screen 1) ties text to audio without a separate timeline.
A floating playback bar above the keyboard while editing (screens 2 to 3) lets you scrub or skip ±5s without leaving edit.
Explicit Done versus pencil header statuses (screens 2 to 4) make enter and exit for inline transcript correction clear.
Highlighter, comment and image actions on the player (screen 1) let the same moment be marked while correcting text.
avoid: A dense metadata header (keywords, speakers, share) above the transcript (screen 1) competes with glanceable playback for gloved faculty.
mobbin:7c04e7a5-ee31-4531-9e1a-fc413f10c.fit: Mobile and iPad app: mobile wins for post-session transcript fix-ups beside the recording. Extends baseline timestamped speech-to-text notes and can feed private debrief moments. It is not a live-room control replacement.

mobbin:6915b30a-9982-4888-a599-f263dc314.summary: From transcript playback the user opens the plus tray, chooses Comment, composes a reply anchored to a timestamp label, and sees it land in a threaded view.
steps: Transcript with highlight, playback and pencil
Plus tray: Comment, Take photo, Add Image
Comment panel: snippet, 24:16 pin, Add Reply
steal: A timestamp pin label on the comment panel (screens 3 to 5) always shows which moment the note belongs to.
A plus tray grouping Comment with photo capture (screen 2) gives one entry for moment evidence.
A snippet of transcript above the compose field (screens 3 to 4) keeps context without leaving the thread.
A comment count next to the timestamp label after post (screen 5) shows the annotation stuck.
avoid: Starting the add path from a small plus on the player (screen 2) is easy to miss for one-hand or gloved use. Prefer a larger Add comment target.
mobbin:6915b30a-9982-4888-a599-f263dc314.fit: Mobile and iPad app: mobile beats fixed SRV for private timestamped faculty notes during playback. Maps directly to baseline debrief annotations. Prefer a web page for shared big-screen control.
